learning_outcomes.text: Acquire knowledge about the use of a process simulation package program (CHEMCAD).
Acquire knowledge about the selection of engineering units and thermodynamic equations in the CHEMCAD simulation computer package program.
Perform the simulation of heat exchangers and reactors in the CHEMCAD simulation computer package program.
Perform the simulation of equipment used in separation processes in the CHEMCAD simulation computer package program.
Perform the simulation of chemical engineering production processes in the ChemCAD simulation computer package program.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Computer Applications in Chemical Engineering
Methods for solving chemical engineering problems
Process flow diagrams and drawing process flow diagrams in ChemCAD
Introduction to ChemCAD program, introduction to program interface, basic information about equipment
Selection of engineering units and thermodynamic equations in ChemCAD
ChemCAD applications: Mixer, flow divider, pump, compressor
ChemCAD applications: Equipment used in separation processes and distillation columns
ChemCAD applications: Equipment used in separation processes and distillation columns
ChemCAD applications: Simulation of production processes
ChemCAD applications: Simulation of production processes
